data: 历史实测：体积来自 TestFlight 1.0.1 (8)，运行性能来自本地验收构建 1.0.1 (1) 的独立模拟器记录；上述数据不代表当前公开发行包。当前公开发行 App Store 1.0.2（2026-10-09 Apple 中国区公开接口回读，免费，iOS 18 起），在售构建号本轮未核实。历史模拟器启动采样前 1 分钟负载 14.17（10 核宿主），速度受当时负载影响。体积不含用户数据与后续缓存
data_en: Historical measurement: sizes are from TestFlight 1.0.1 (8); runtime figures are from a separate local acceptance build 1.0.1 (1) in the simulator. These measurements do not represent the current published package. Current public release: App Store 1.0.2, free, iOS 18+ (Apple China lookup on 2026-10-09); the live build number was not verified in this run. The historical simulator launch sample began at a 1-minute host load of 14.17 on 10 cores, which affects timing. Sizes exclude user data and later caches
